import subprocess
from pathlib import Path


def test_agent_guard_cli_help_probe():
    guard = Path('/usr/local/bin/agent_guard.py')
    assert guard.is_file(), 'AGENT_GUARD_NOT_FOUND'
    result = subprocess.run(
        ['/app/.venv/bin/python', str(guard), '--help'],
        text=True,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
        timeout=20,
        check=False,
    )
    raise AssertionError('AGENT_GUARD_HELP_BEGIN\n' + result.stdout + '\nAGENT_GUARD_HELP_END')
